method: Pinned source read and independent Python arithmetic only; no C++ execution. Original decimal literals remain in the TSVs. Source reference probabilities are rounded to f32 as in Peak1D. CBr2 exact masses/probabilities are separately derived from ElementDB isotope masses and f32-rounded natural abundances using the closed-form two-atom binomial. No native Rust generator produced expected fixture values. Package tests require no .reference checkout or /tmp artifacts.

comparison_policies.IsoSpec_test: my_real_similar(a,b) is a*(1-1e-7)<=b<=a*(1+1e-7), no absolute floor. Reference probability is first rounded into Peak1D f32. getConf().intensity must equal static_cast<float>(getIntensity()). Raw getIntensity must be similar to exp(getLogIntensity()).
comparison_policies.Fine_class_test: Uses TEST_REAL_SIMILAR default tolerances, not the explicit IsoSpec 1e-7 helper. ClassTest.h is absent from this first-party snapshot, so the global default tolerance is not asserted here. Older Fine scalar literals sometimes differ visibly from the stronger IsoSpec table; retain but do not promote them to exact high-precision oracles.
comparison_policies.header_example: Illustrative partial decimal output ending with ellipsis, no executable comparison tolerance, and a cutoff inconsistency; not an exact selected-set golden.
comparison_policies.counts: Exact integer source assertions; backend-sensitive untrimmed coverage output counts deliberately have no expected count.

fructose.comparison: 1e-7 relative bounds with no absolute floor, following source my_real_similar. Source reference Peak1D probabilities are already f32.

bromine.comparison: Rounded integer mass labels and old literal probabilities use an explicit native absolute 1e-7 allowance; separate derived masses use 1e-10 absolute and derived stored-f32 probabilities use exact equality. This allowance is not claimed to be an inspected ClassTest default.
bromine.source_size_note: Source iterates result without an explicit size-6 assertion; six independently follows two carbon isotope choices times three Br2 isotope compositions.

count_scope: All 44 active source count cases from the temporary independent source inventory; coverage .99 for fructose derives from the exact source Fine missing-probability 0.01 call. C100H202 complete count 20503 derives from the source 101*203 assertion. Untrimmed layered wrapper counts are unspecified and are not tested.
excluded_illustrations: The C100H202 header nine-row partial illustration is not bundled as a selected-set oracle: its last probability .0015837649 is below .01 times maximum .3603877127, or .0036038771. Older Fine fructose approximate values disagree with the stronger IsoSpec 14-row table and are not silently substituted.

independent_coverage_boundary.origin: Separate independent Python prototype, not C++ output
independent_coverage_boundary.interpretation: At 19615 configurations, raw f64 coverage remains below the target while f32-rounded coverage crosses it; source literal count 19615 independently confirms stored-f32 trimming matters.
independent_coverage_boundary.note: Recorded prototype and results hashes identify the independent derivation during development; package tests use literal expected source count and stored sum only.

api_scope: Tests target materialized FineIsotopePatternGenerator. They do not claim the absent IsoSpec layered streaming backend, arbitrary custom-enrichment wrapper APIs or backend tie identity/order are implemented.
native_numeric_contract: Natural abundances are f32-rounded and not normalized. Internal probability computation uses f64 logarithms; output probabilities are narrowed to f32 and widened into native f64 IsotopePeak fields; coverage uses those stored values. Formula charge behavior and resource/error controls have separate owner tests.
